svg.title: Velocity and acceleration in four cases
svg.desc: Rightward motion speeds up with rightward acceleration and slows with leftward acceleration. Leftward motion slows with rightward acceleration and speeds up with leftward acceleration. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Acceleration changes velocity, including its sign
All four motions share the same clock; negative acceleration can increase speed.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
